name: conical-shade
why: A lampshade in closed form: a frustum shell open at both ends, outer radius 30 at z = 0 to 20 at z = 40, the inner surface the outer moved 1.6 in along the radius. Volume pi * integral of (3.2 R - 2.56) dz = 3097.6 pi = 9731.468 mm3, recorded 0.028% under, on the tessellation. The wall between two surfaces sloping 10 in 40 is 1.6 * 40 / sqrt(1700) = 1.5522 mm. At the two open rims every sample reads thinner — a ball there is wedged against the end face at 76 or 104 degrees — and those are edge readings, not the thinnest wall; the shade from which this case was drawn read 0.81 mm at its rims under a ray sweep.
